Standard inspection criteria

Quality Control Guidelines

01

Minimum curing Complete the approved curing target, normally 28 days, before final inspection.

02

Visual integrity No structural cracks, severe chips, exposed reinforcement, or deformation.

03

Dimensions and weight Measurements must remain within the approved design tolerance.

04

Strength verification Compressive or handling checks must meet the facility threshold.

05

Documentation Observations, inspection result, and Faculty remarks are required.
